title: new's page does not say that the stub search skips other work trees and every copy of devbin's runtime, as 0353's fix made it
body:
## What happened

Issue 0353's fix (unit 0353-1, landed at a6d261e1 for 0.1.26) made `new`'s search for a test suite drop a hit inside any copy of devbin's runtime (`bin/.devbin/lib/`), not only the project's own, and a hit beneath a directory below the root that holds a `.git`, file or directory: another work tree or a nested repository. `new`'s page, lib/pages/new.md:20, still says only that the stub goes beside "the first `.bats` file found under the project root, in sorted path order", and that `new` "never writes into devbin's runtime, which ships the template the stub is made from". It says neither that another work tree, a nested repository or another copy of the runtime is passed over, nor that `new` never writes into one.

## Why it matters

The page is what a user reads before running `new`. 0353's reporter removed a stray stub by hand because the page had promised none. The fixed behaviour answers that report, and it is not written where the reporter would look.

## The fix

The stub paragraph says the search passes over every copy of devbin's runtime and every directory below the root that holds a `.git`, so `new` never writes into another work tree or a nested repository. Found while closing 0353 (2026-11-16); filed for 0.1.27 on vc's decision 205, to ride with 0358's unit.

## Resolution

cc, 2026-11-17 12:03Z by date -u: fixed by unit 0358-1, landed at e9ae374a for 0.1.27, riding 0358's unit on vc's word. new's page (lib/pages/new.md) says the stub search passes over every copy of devbin's runtime, `bin/.devbin/lib/`, the project's own and any other, and everything beneath a directory below the root that holds a `.git`, file or directory, so a linked worktree or a nested repository is never read as this project's suite, and `new` never writes into one. Arm: documentation.bats's 0358-1 arm on new's page, red at the base and green at the tip under BSD and GNU (Desk slot 01M7MN581DQ20NSCPEW4Q7FEE7).
